messages.content: i have already cleaned the kitchen, but i have not washed the cups.
the kitchen is clean, and the cups still need washing.
can i say i have done all the work?
not if washing the cups is part of the work you mean.
just tell me what is still left.
washing the cups.
i was reading when my sister came home.
did you stop reading to talk with her?
yes. she had a nice day and came to tell me about it.
you listened to her instead of reading.
what was i doing before she came?
you were reading.
when i get home, i will put my bag away and make tea.
you can put the bag away first, then make tea.
what if my mother is already making tea?
then you may not need to make more. you could ask if she is making some for you too.
what can i ask?
are you making tea for me too?
could you help me write a short note to my father?
yes. what would you like it to say?
i will be home after dinner, not before.
i will be home after dinner.
please keep after. i need that in the note.
i will be home after dinner.
i was going to visit my friend, but she was busy.
did you choose another time to visit?
we chose tomorrow afternoon.
then your new plan is to visit tomorrow afternoon.
when was i going to visit before?
you had not said the first day or time. you only said you were going to visit.
if i had a free afternoon, i would read in the garden.
that could be a quiet way to spend it.
does that mean i have a free afternoon today?
no. you are saying what you would do if you had one.
where would i read?
in the garden.
i made this little box. help me write that with the box first.
this little box was made by me.
now say my sister made it instead.
this little box was made by my sister.
did you keep the box first in the sentence?
yes.
write about the woman who helped me find my bag.
the woman who helped me find my bag was kind.
do not add that she is my mother. i do not know her.
the woman who helped me find my bag was kind.
what did she help me find?
your bag.
we met at the library yesterday. where did we meet?
at the library.
and when?
yesterday.
can you put both answers in one sentence?
you met at the library yesterday.
my brother cooked while i put the cups on the table.
you were getting the meal ready together.
did i cook too?
you did not say you cooked. you put the cups on the table.
who was cooking?
your brother.
i do not want coffee, and i do not want tea.
would you like water instead?
yes, just water.
then you want water.
did i ask for tea?
no. you said you did not want it.
write a question asking if i may sit here.
may i sit here?
now ask if my sister can sit with me too.
may my sister sit with me too?
just the first question again.
may i sit here?
ask my friend if we should go home now. use shall.
shall we go home now?
change home to the park.
shall we go to the park now?
is it still a question for both of us?
yes. we is you and your friend here.
i will have finished my book before dinner. can i plan a walk after that?
you can plan a walk after finishing the book, if you have time.
have i finished it already just because i said that?
no. you said what you think you will have done before dinner.
write a short sentence about the plan.
i will walk after i finish my book.
i had washed my hands before i ate. which came first?
washing your hands came first.
now say the same order in a simple sentence.
i washed my hands, then i ate.
did i eat before washing them?
no.
i often read after lunch, but today i am going to the park.
today you are doing another thing after lunch.
does that change what i often do?
no. you can often do one thing and do another thing today.
what is the plan for today?
going to the park.
i was inside because there was rain. make that simple.
i was inside because there was rain.
now make it about tomorrow if there is rain.
if there is rain tomorrow, i will stay inside.
does that tell you tomorrow weather for sure?
no. it is a plan for if there is rain.
i want to say i will visit my aunt even if there is rain.
i will visit my aunt even if there is rain.
does rain make me stop the visit in that sentence?
no. the sentence says you will visit even with rain.
now say i will take my coat too.
i will take my coat and visit my aunt even if there is rain.
ask my brother if this is his coat.
is this your coat?
now ask my sister instead. do the words have to change?
no. you can ask your sister: is this your coat?
who is your about in that new question?
your sister.
i chose the blue cup, not the red one. which cup did i choose?
the blue cup.
did i say there is no red cup?
no. you said you did not choose it.
just the color i chose.
blue.
i have been working all morning. i want a quiet lunch.
what would you like to have for lunch?
soup and bread. i do not want to talk about work.
soup and bread can be your quiet lunch. we can leave work out of the talk.
what did i say i want?
a quiet lunch with soup and bread.
write that my sister can sing and dance. use not only and but also.
my sister can not only sing but also dance.
now make it about my brother.
my brother can not only sing but also dance.
did you leave out the part about dance?
no. the sentence says he can sing and dance.
make she is reading a book into a question.
is she reading a book?
now make it about they.
are they reading a book?
what changed at the start?
is changed to are, and she changed to they.
ask if my cousin went to the market yesterday.
did my cousin go to the market yesterday?
why go instead of went in the question?
after did, we use go in this question.
just the question again.
did my cousin go to the market yesterday?
write that i will not go to the park tomorrow.
i will not go to the park tomorrow.
does that say i never go to the park?
no. it only says you will not go tomorrow.
now write that i will go today instead.
i will go to the park today instead.
my first note is long. can you make it shorter?
please share the note you want me to make shorter.
i want to ask if my friend can come to my house tomorrow in the afternoon.
can you come to my house tomorrow afternoon?
did you keep the day and part of the day?
yes. tomorrow afternoon is still there.
i am making lunch now, so i cannot go out.
you are making lunch, so you cannot go out right now.
i just want to tell my friend why i cannot come now.
i am making lunch, so i cannot come now.
just that note.
i am making lunch, so i cannot come now.
ask my mother if she knows where my book is.
do you know where my book is?
should it say where is my book at the end instead?
in this question, do you know where my book is is the right order.
just write it once more.
do you know where my book is?
write a sentence with as i walked home.
as i walked home, i saw a bird in a tree.
keep the start but change the bird to my sister.
as i walked home, i saw my sister.
did i get home before seeing her in that sentence?
no. you saw her while you were walking home.
write a sentence with we had already finished.
we had already finished lunch when our friend came.
does that mean my friend came here today?
no. it is an example sentence, not a thing you said about today.
can i use it in a story?
yes.
